name: MeshClient
description: A Meshtastic client for your handheld: read and send messages, browse the mesh, and edit your radio's settings over Bluetooth LE or USB.
author: mcereal

changelog.v2.21.0: Give the meter a domain and drawn threshold bands, and lists a signal staircase; Only draw a signal staircase where the reading is the node's own.
changelog.v2.20.0: Draw the chrome as a navigation bar and an action bar; Name the compose sheet's A for the row under the cursor.
changelog.v2.19.0: Add a spacing scale and a type scale; Keep the row a title did not actually cost.
changelog.v2.18.0: Add motion tokens and a list scroll rail.
changelog.v2.17.0: Restructure the palette as six Material colour families; Keep theme.h C++-includable and let the Radio card see its warnings.
